title: Tech tree node
description: One entry in data/nodes.json. Branch, tag and criterion ids must exist in data/taxonomy.json; parent ids must exist in data/nodes.json. scripts/validate.mjs enforces these cross-file rules.

id.description: Stable unique id. Never reuse or rename.

date.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Use the precision you can source.

branch.description: Branch or sub-branch id from taxonomy.json.

parents.description: Nodes this one builds on or is caused by. Must not form a cycle.

level.description: 1 = milestone (always visible), 2 = important (layer view), 3 = detail (deepest zoom).

kind.description: constraint = policy, supply or power limit; upcoming = scheduled future event.

source.description: Who published it. Use a plain string when the name is the same in both languages.

criteria.description: Why this counts; ids from taxonomy.json criteria.

status.description: candidate = proposed by the agent, awaiting human review.

agent_reason.description: Required for candidates: why the agent proposed this node and where.
